description: With an unknown for_each, a static traversal of a generated block's attribute fails
notes: The spec's static analyses read an expression as written, and with a known for_each hashicorp/hcl analyzes the content's expressions (see native/dynamic-blocks/static-traversal-of-iterator), while the README only makes the attributes derived from the iteration unknown when for_each is. hashicorp/hcl replaces the expression of every attribute of a block generated from an unknown for_each with the constant dynamic value (unknownBody.fixupAttrs in ext/dynblock/unknown_body.go), which has no syntax to analyze.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
